title: Metacognitive Meditation
skills: reflect on personal thinking and learning processes
identify habits, assumptions, and patterns that influence understanding
use metacognitive awareness to improve reading, writing, and problem solving
practice intentional reflection before revising or evaluating academic work
alignment_note: Supports metacognitive reflection by encouraging students to observe their own thinking, attention, and learning processes. Can reinforce reflective writing, self-assessment, revision planning, and independent learning habits across high school English courses.
